pages.quiz:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #9 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is "ich" written with a small letter in the middle of a sentence? (1 mark)
   A. It is a place
   B. It is not a noun or a name
   C. It is a verb
   D. It is always small

2. Which German word or phrase means "very good"? (1 mark)
   A. Bis bald
   B. Guten Abend
   C. Entschuldigung
   D. Sehr gut

3. Which German word or phrase means "brother"? (1 mark)
   A. der Bruder
   B. die Familie
   C. der Freund
   D. die Schwester

4. Which German word or phrase means "family"? (1 mark)
   A. der Sohn
   B. der Freund
   C. der Onkel
   D. die Familie

5. Which German word or phrase means "house"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kühlschrank
   B. die Toilette
   C. das Schlafzimmer
   D. das Haus

6. Which German word or phrase means "spoon"? (1 mark)
   A. der Löffel
   B. die Toilette
   C. die Gabel
   D. die Lampe

7. Which German word means "to dance"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. kochen
   B. tanzen
   C. lesen
   D. duschen

8. What does "lernen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to speak
   B. to help
   C. to drink
   D. to learn or study

9. What does "der zweite" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. first
   B. third
   C. seventh
   D. second

10. What does "Februar" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. February
   B. March
   C. August
   D. October

11. What does "Juni" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. March
   B. April
   C. February
   D. June

12. Which German word or phrase means "apple"? (1 mark)
   A. das Brot
   B. das Fleisch
   C. der Fisch
   D. der Apfel

13. Which German word or phrase means "watermelon"? (1 mark)
   A. der Apfel
   B. die Wassermelone
   C. die Tomate
   D. das Fleisch

14. Which food group does "die Zwiebel" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. die Getränke
   C. das Fleisch
   D. das Obst

15. Which German word or phrase means "hair"? (1 mark)
   A. das Auge
   B. das Haar
   C. der Kopf
   D. der Finger

16. Which German word or phrase means "neck"? (1 mark)
   A. der Zahn
   B. die Hand
   C. der Hals
   D. der Finger

17. Which verb means "blows" in "Der Wind ___"? (1 mark)
   A. scheint
   B. regnet
   C. schneit
   D. weht

18. Which German word means "cloudy"? (weather) (1 mark)
   A. trocken
   B. wolkig
   C. windig
   D. kalt

19. Which completes "Die Katze sitzt ___ dem Tisch" (under)? (1 mark)
   A. unter
   B. über
   C. auf
   D. vor

20. What does "in" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. in
   B. behind
   C. on
   D. between

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write three sentences that say which item is in which room. (3 marks)

22. Write the German words with der, die or das for: onion, parents, ear, cloud, cake. (5 marks)

23. Write the German words with der, die or das for: water, rice, breakfast. (3 marks)

24. Unscramble and write with the article: FELPA and SERI. (4 marks)

25. Write a four-line dialogue in German between two friends who meet in the morning and say goodbye. (4 marks)

26. Write in German: "The lamp is next to the bed." (2 marks)

27. Describe a floor plan of your dream house in German. Name at least three rooms. (3 marks)

28. Write the German words with der, die or das for: table, fridge, kitchen. (3 marks)

29. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bed, birthday, banana. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #9 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — It is not a noun or a name
   Ich is only capital at the start of a sentence, unlike English I.

2. D — Sehr gut
   very good in German is Sehr gut.

3. A — der Bruder
   brother in German is der Bruder.

4. D — die Familie
   family in German is die Familie.

5. D — das Haus
   house in German is das Haus.

6. A — der Löffel
   spoon in German is der Löffel.

7. B — tanzen
   to dance in German is tanzen.

8. D — to learn or study
   lernen means to learn or study.

9. D — second
   der zweite means second.

10. A — February
   Februar means February.

11. D — June
   Juni means June.

12. D — der Apfel
   apple in German is der Apfel.

13. B — die Wassermelone
   watermelon in German is die Wassermelone.

14. A — das Gemüse
   die Zwiebel belongs to das Gemüse.

15. B — das Haar
   hair in German is das Haar.

16. C — der Hals
   neck in German is der Hals.

17. D — weht
   Der Wind weht means the wind blows.

18. B — wolkig
   cloudy in German is wolkig.

19. A — unter
   unter means under.

20. A — in
   in means in.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer. Der Tisch ist in der Küche. Das Sofa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

22. (5 marks)
   Answer: die Zwiebel, die Eltern, das Ohr, die Wolke, der Kuchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Wasser, der Reis, das Frühstück.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Apfel and der Reis.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word and 1 mark for each article.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: A: Guten Morgen, Amina! B: Guten Morgen, Otieno! Wie geht's? A: Gut, danke. B: Tschüss!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct line with capital letters and punctuation.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: Die Lampe ist neben dem Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the sentence pattern and 1 mark for neben dem Bett.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das ist die Küche. Das ist das Wohnzimmer. Das ist das Schlafzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each room correctly named.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Tisch, der Kühlschrank, die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Bett, der Geburtstag, die Banane.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).
